optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Process Data Analyst, Steel Rolling Mill
professionalSummary: Process data analyst with three years of experience at a steel rolling mill, specializing in building and maintaining process monitoring dashboards from sensor and quality laboratory data for two rolling lines.
experienceHighlights: Built and maintained process monitoring dashboards from mill sensor and quality laboratory data for two rolling lines.
Investigated thirty-one out-of-specification events with mill engineers under the investigation procedure; findings accepted and corrective actions implemented.
Prepared weekly process reviews for the mill manager, filed in the process data folder.
Supported process change trials, recording trial analyses and mill manager approvals, and distinguishing responsibilities between myself and the automation team.
Authored limitation sections and hand-over conditions for each investigation and trial analysis.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Dashboard specification; investigation register extract for one quarter with accepted findings; weekly process review; trial record with approval, all referenced in the process data folder.
skills: Documentation of analysis limitations and hand-over conditions
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample sources establish the candidate’s experience and responsibilities related to dashboard building, investigation of out-of-spec events, weekly reviews, process change trial support, and documentation of limitations. They do not provide evidence of interactions with mill engineers beyond the investigation procedure or of the candidate’s ability to persuade skeptical engineers.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess fit for the Process Data Analyst role.

role.roleTitle: Process Data Analyst, Steel Rolling Mill

evidence.text: Process data analyst at a steel rolling mill for three years, building and maintaining the process monitoring dashboards from the mill's sensor and quality laboratory data for the two rolling lines.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of dashboard building and maintenance.

evidence.text: Investigated the out-of-specification events with the mill engineers under the investigation procedure; the investigation register records thirty-one investigations with my findings accepted by the mill engineers and the corrective actions they took.
evidence.notes: Explicit investigation procedure and acceptance by engineers.

evidence.text: Prepared the weekly process review for the mill manager, with the reviews filed in the process data folder.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of weekly review preparation.

evidence.text: Supported the process change trials with the trial analyses; the change approvals were the mill manager's, recorded on each trial record together with which analyses were mine and which the automation team's.
evidence.notes: Shows support for trials and recording of responsibilities.

evidence.text: Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each investigation and each trial analysis.
evidence.notes: Direct documentation of limitations and hand-over.
